vocabulary.definition: a union or association formed for mutual benefit, especially between countries or organizations.
vocabulary.example: The alliance between the two countries helped strengthen their economies.

vocabulary.definition: done by people acting as a group.
vocabulary.example: The collective effort of the team led to their success.

vocabulary.definition: a party that has signed an agreement, especially a country that has signed a treaty.
vocabulary.example: The signatory nations pledged to uphold the terms of the treaty.

vocabulary.definition: an area of land under the jurisdiction of a ruler or state.
vocabulary.example: The empire expanded its territories through conquest.

vocabulary.definition: the action of protecting someone or something.
vocabulary.example: The security guard provided protection for the valuable artifacts.

vocabulary.definition: relating to the nucleus of an atom or to a nucleus, especially the nucleus of an atom undergoing fission or fusion.
vocabulary.example: The country invested in nuclear technology to meet its energy needs.
